Meteorology

寒潮警报

An official warning issued to inform mariners of an expected period of unusually low temperatures, which may affect vessel systems and crew safety.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 寒潮警报?

In this glossary, 寒潮警报 refers to: An official warning issued to inform mariners of an expected period of unusually low temperatures, which may affect vessel systems and crew safety.

How is 寒潮警报 used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "所有船舶请注意：寒潮警报生效。请确保供暖系统运行正常，船员防寒措施到位。"

Why does 寒潮警报 matter in maritime?

寒潮警报 matters because it supports clear communication in Meteorology contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses 寒潮警报?

寒潮警报 is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does 寒潮警报 belong to?

In this glossary, 寒潮警报 is grouped under Meteorology. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

An official warning issued to inform mariners of an expected period of unusually low temperatures, which may affect vessel systems and crew safety.

Operational example

Attention all vessels: Cold Spell Warning in force. Ensure heating systems are operational and crew exposed to elements are protected.

Localized term

寒潮警报

Localized example

所有船舶请注意：寒潮警报生效。请确保供暖系统运行正常，船员防寒措施到位。
